newsitem.title: USA: Cole National sees lower '97 gross margins.
newsitem.headline: Cole National sees lower '97 gross margins.

text.p: Cole National Corp said Tuesday it expects its consolidated gross margin in the 1997 fiscal year to decline because of its acquisition of Pearle Inc.
Cole acquired Pearle in November 1996 from the Pillsbury Co, a unit of Grand Metropolitan Plc, for about $165 million.
The company said it anticipates the lower gross margin in 1997 because Pearle has a lower gross margin than the rest of the company's divisions.
It attributed Pearle's lower gross margin to higher costs of in-store laboratories and lower margin wholesale sales to franchised stores.
Cole's gross margin in 1996 was 68.6 percent of revenues compared with 68.3 percent in 1995.
Cole National sells eyeglasses and optometric services.
